independent_ground_truth.ground_truth_method: Enumerate all 20 monotone Boolean functions, keep every completion agreeing with the observed coalition subset, compute exact Shapley for every feasible completion, and maximize directly.

scope: These checks validate the formula and implementation for monotone simple games under point observations. They do not establish monotonicity for real finite-compute proof utility and therefore do not authorize direct lemma-library promotion/demotion.
